consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance on March 12, 1966, showcases the early Grateful Dead's raw energy and blues influences, particularly highlighting Pigpen's strong vocals. Many reviewers appreciate the historical significance of the show, noting standout moments in several songs despite some confusion over the exact setlist.
